summary: FP2 1.1.3 on muOS (Anbernic RG40XX-H, Allwinner H700): pad admitted, GPTK alive, controls displaced (confirm on L1, no jump, SELECT+START dead). Receipt: NXC6-DOMAIN ... rewritten=1 rewritten_bindings=15 volume_markers=2 result=rewritten; NXC6-SEAM source_domain=joydev-legacy target_domain=sdl2-evdev.

device.ev_key_note: 0x130..0x13c and 0x72/0x73 are the vendor gpio-keys table (MustardOS/Knulli DTS, see framework-v4 tests/test_evdev_chord_map.c). The third low key is present on the real node (muOS mapping binds volumedown=b1/volumeup=b2, so exactly ONE key precedes 0x72); its exact code is NOT proven by any pinned source. 0x11 is carried from the V4 fixture as a placeholder < 0x72; the reproduction and the fix do not depend on its value.

physical_table.trust_root: vendor DTS gpio-keys (MustardOS internal / knulli-linux boot_package dts), transcribed in framework-v4 tests/test_evdev_chord_map.c lines 3-9
physical_table.plastic_legend_note: muOS offers modern (A=south) and retro (A=east) user preference; the legend is evidence only. The Xbox surface is positional.

source.provenance: official muOS line for GUID 1900...0000 as pinned in framework-v4 ports/fp2/controllers-retro.nxb line 14 (seed/counter-proof, not the causal bytes of the field session)
source.domain_claimed: sdl2-batocera-ascending (the muOS SDL2 carries the Batocera patch set; the CFW authors ordinals for its own SDL)

provider_loaded.method_in_field: UNMEASURED (no NXC6-PROVIDER line existed in V4); asserted by the muOS build recipe (Batocera SDL2 patch set) and by the field symptom chain; the Knulli sibling DSO 8c4dc956... is the pinned representative of the same patch set
provider_loaded.note: The exact muOS DSO sha256 is NOT pinned in this fixture. K7 stays BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DEVICE until a receipt from the device exists.
